result.summary: This pedal is mostly made of machined aluminum alloy with steel hardware and internal bearings.

parts.name: Pedal body
parts.process_detail: Machined from solid aluminum billet on multi axis CNC mills to create the platform shape.
parts.fun_fact: CNC machined pedal bodies can be hollowed out to save up to 100 grams per pair.

parts.name: Threaded spindle
parts.process_detail: Steel rod is turned on a lathe and threads are cut to standard pedal specifications.
parts.fun_fact: Left pedals have reverse threads to prevent them unscrewing during normal pedaling motion.

parts.name: Traction pins
parts.process_detail: Small threaded pins are turned from steel rod and heat treated for durability.
parts.fun_fact: Replaceable traction pins can be adjusted or removed to customize grip levels for different shoes.

parts.name: Sealed cartridge bearings
parts.process_detail: Precision ground steel balls are assembled into races with rubber seals and grease.
parts.fun_fact: Sealed cartridge bearings can last over 10,000 miles in wet conditions without maintenance.

parts.name: Dust cap
parts.process_detail: Small cap is turned on a lathe with hex socket for installation and removal.
parts.fun_fact: The dust cap often hides an adjustment mechanism for bearing preload on higher end pedals.

parts.name: Platform surface
parts.process_detail: Machined aluminum surface is anodized for corrosion resistance and a matte black finish.
parts.fun_fact: Anodizing creates a ceramic layer that is harder than the base aluminum underneath.

parts.name: Cutout windows
parts.process_detail: Material is removed during CNC machining to reduce weight while maintaining structural integrity.
parts.fun_fact: Strategic cutouts can reduce pedal weight by 30 percent without sacrificing strength or stiffness.

journey.title: Aluminum billet production
journey.detail: Aluminum ingots are extruded into solid billets of 6061 alloy for machining.

journey.title: CNC machining
journey.detail: Billets are machined on multi axis CNC mills to create the pedal body shape.

journey.title: Surface treatment
journey.detail: Pedal bodies are anodized for corrosion resistance and aesthetic finish.

journey.title: Bearing installation
journey.detail: Sealed cartridge bearings are pressed into the body and spindle is threaded in.

journey.title: Hardware installation
journey.detail: Traction pins are threaded into the body and dust cap is installed.

journey.title: Distribution to retailers
journey.detail: Finished pedals are packaged in pairs and shipped to bike shops worldwide.
